title: Hall of Mirrors
reference: repeat 2 { while not wall_ahead { forward } turn_right }
hints: The halls are different lengths. A while loop asks each bot about its own hall.
Repeat 2: (while no wall ahead: forward), turn right.
repeat 2 { while not wall_ahead { forward } turn_right }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Mirror Hall. The two spires look alike, but they aren't the same inside. Sensors read each bot's own surroundings."
story.outro: PATCH: "Same program, and each bot turned at its own wall. That's the trick of this hall."
